description: Templated reaction-roll flavor lines for the HiringPanel. Source: acore_equipment.xml §reaction_to_hiring_offer. The keys mirror HenchmanLoyaltyResolver.HIRE_* outcome strings exactly. Each list is randomly sampled per interview to keep the player from memorizing fixed copy. {name} placeholder substituted per call.

refuse_slander: {name} sneers at the offer and walks off, muttering about 'cheapskate adventurers' to anyone who'll listen. (Future hires in this town: -1.)
{name} laughs in your face. The whole tavern hears it. (Future hires in this town: -1.)
{name} insults your lineage and storms out. Word will travel. (Future hires in this town: -1.)
refuse: {name} declines politely and returns to their drink.
{name} shakes their head — 'No thank you, sirrah' — and turns away.
{name} hears you out, then says they're not interested.
try_again: {name} folds their arms. 'Make it worth my while and I might.'
{name} hesitates — they want better terms before they'll commit.
{name} squints. 'I've heard your offer. I want a sweeter one.'
{name} looks unconvinced. They'd come if the deal improved.
accept: {name} extends a hand. 'You've got yourself a henchman.'
{name} accepts the offer with quiet professionalism.
{name} agrees. 'Pay's pay. Let's see what you're made of.'
accept_elan: {name}'s eyes light up. 'A real adventure! Count me in!' (+1 morale.)
{name} grins broadly. 'I've been waiting for an offer like this!' (+1 morale.)
{name} clasps your forearm. 'I'll follow you anywhere.' (+1 morale.)
{name} cheers loud enough to startle the barkeep. (+1 morale.)
